description: Source code for the InterleavedSincResampler class, implementing a high-quality audio resampling algorithm with kernel initialization, buffer management, and convolution-based resampling.

classes.name: InterleavedSincResampler
classes.description: A class implementing an interleaved sinc resampling algorithm for audio data.

methods.name: InitializeKernel
methods.description: Generates windowed sinc kernels with Blackman windowing for resampling.

methods.name: GetNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames currently cached in the internal buffer.

methods.name: QueueBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for resampling.

methods.name: Resample
methods.description: Performs resampling on queued input data into the destination buffer.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Resets internal state and clears queued buffers.

methods.name: CanQueueBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a new buffer can be queued.

methods.name: HasEnoughData
methods.description: Checks if there is enough data to perform resampling for a given number of frames.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from queued buffers into the destination buffer.

methods.name: Convolve
methods.description: Performs convolution of input data with sinc kernels for resampling.
